title: Spearmint Candy Cane
body:
About

The Spearmint Candycane Tree is the green version of the Candy Cane which is *slightly* less rare.

They can be found in the Candycane Meteor along with normal candy canes. The tree was originally introduced in 1.71.0 and was reintroduced in v1.97.0 as a limited time tree that spawned around the map.

Details

The Spearmint Candy Cane Tree is a large curving tree with no leaves. Its durability is similar to that of a Magma Tree when struck by any axe. However, if the Festive Axe is used to cut the Spearmint Candy Cane Tree, it gains an Emberbane-like effect where it can chop the tree in only a few hits, which is the same as the normal candy cane tree.

Extra Info

After 1.97.5, Giant candycanes could also be found in this green varient
